name: Annie Winters
source:
Annie is Orion's childhood neighbor and his first friend after he moved to England.

Orion  chose her and Chang as his companions in the Student Exchange Program.


Short but mighty, Annie is shy, cute and quiet, but she transforms when she logs into Eternum.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/eternum-sneak-4-53835689]Patreon[/url]]
